title: Compatibility and Human/Device Qualification
blockingPolicy: any observed FAIL in required external-reader coverage
any observed FAIL in required physical-device workflow coverage
acceptance: Malformed, scanned, form-heavy, encrypted, signed, multilingual and large real-world cases are represented by human-attested hash-only evidence.
Every v7.2 output workflow is reopened in an appropriate external application with exact output SHA-256 and exact application/OS version.
At least two independent PDF-reader families are represented, including one native/non-browser reader, and DOCX is opened in an external office reader.
Physical phone, physical tablet and installed-PWA observations cover all affected v7.2 workflows.
Automation, browser emulation, simulators, CI and AI-generated observations never satisfy human/device gates.
Unresolved compatibility/data-loss/high-severity failures block P18 certification.
P18 changes qualification tooling only; product source, executable version and persistent schemas remain frozen.
